evals.name: html-deck-from-prd
evals.prompt: I've got a PRD at ~/Dev/dAIolog/docs/alfabs-9-slide-deck-prompt.md. Build me a 6-slide HTML deck out of it for an engineering all-hands - something I can just open in a browser and present. Save it to /tmp/deck-eval-0/deck.html
evals.expected_output: Single self-contained HTML file, fixed 1920x1080 stage that scales+letterboxes, 6 slides, type at projection sizes, committed direction, no filler slides.

evals.name: pptx-board-pack
evals.prompt: Need a 5-slide board pack as an actual .pptx I can open in PowerPoint. Topic: Q3 engineering update - shipped the new auth system, cut p95 latency from 840ms to 210ms, headcount went 14 to 17, two incidents (both resolved, 4h total downtime), Q4 is the migration off the legacy queue. Put it in /tmp/deck-eval-1/
evals.expected_output: deck.json authored as lecturn.deck/1, validated, converted to .pptx. stat.value fields are short figures not prose. No group/widget/embed elements.

evals.name: diolog-investor-templates
evals.prompt: Author the 9-slide ALFABS investor update described in ~/Dev/dAIolog/docs/alfabs-9-slide-deck-prompt.md. Work in /tmp/deck-eval-2/ and write deck.json there. The slide template library is at ~/Dev/dAIolog/scripts/generated/diolog-slide-templates-skill/
evals.expected_output: lecturn.deck/1 deck.json using templateId+slots from the library, x.diolog.structure with one entry per slide in order, theme.tokens set to ALFABS charcoal/red/Figtree, no invented figures.

gate_evals.how: Runs the current scripts/ and a snapshot of the previous version against the same fixtures with the same flags, and marks 17 structural assertions PASS or FAIL on each with the evidence it judged on. Artifact checks, not scores.
gate_evals.fixtures: evals/fixtures/ — one deck per defect class, plus clean.html as the false-positive control and regress.html as the no-regression guard.
gate_evals.result: evals/results/scorecard.md — original 3/17, rebuild 17/17 as at 18 Aug 2026.
gate_evals.note: A5 and A17 interact: the previous version intermittently reports 'PASS ... across 0 slides examined' at roughly 1 run in 4, which would make every other blocker look like it stopped firing. The harness retries a zero-denominator run once and logs that it had to, so the zero-denominator defect is scored by A5 alone.

assertions.asserts: a --regulated run whose config was defeated by a reformatted probe does not print PASS
chart coverage is reported with its denominator
a declared two-bar group with a truncated axis is judged
a run that examined zero slides is not a pass
every blocker carries its downstream consequence
a generic deck title or filename is gated
drawn accent marks count toward the accent budget, not only text leaves
a slide leading on a non-IFRS measure needs its statutory companion on that slide
dual and inverted axes are caught
a misspelled config key is refused rather than ignored
the browser's own stderr is relayed verbatim
CONTROL — a genuinely clean deck still passes, over a real denominator
the verdict names what was actually gated
a check that threw is reported as unrun rather than as clean
an empty probe result is refused and says so
NO REGRESSION — pre-existing blockers still fire
